query: INSERT INTO social_media_streamer_layout (streamer_login, layout_json, cam_enabled, mode, updated_at, updated_by) VALUES ($1, $2::text::jsonb, $3, $4, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, $5) ON CONFLICT (streamer_login) DO UPDATE SET layout_json = EXCLUDED.layout_json, cam_enabled = EXCLUDED.cam_enabled, mode = EXCLUDED.mode, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
